title: Future in the past · 过去的将来
pattern: was / were going to + base verb  ·  was / were about to + base verb  ·  would + base verb  ·  was / were to (have) + V3
summary: 从过去的某个时间点看将来，要用 was going to、was about to、would 或 was to，而不是 will。
explanation: 说话的时间点不同，“将来”的形式也不同。如果叙述的是过去的事情，而事情在那个时刻之后才发生，英语不用 will，而要用过去将来的形式。中文会说“那时他打算……”“他当时就要……”，英语则根据语境选择 was going to、was about to、would 或 was to。
**was / were going to + 动词原形**表示过去的计划或根据迹象作出的预测：It **was going to rain**, so we took umbrellas.（看样子要下雨，所以我们带了伞。）与 would 相比，going to 更强调已有的打算或迹象，因此常用于有明显依据的情况。
**was / were about to + 动词原形**表示“正要做某事”，几乎立刻就会发生，常与 when 连用：I **was about to leave** when the boss asked me to stay.。注意：about to 后面不能再接具体的时间状语，如 tomorrow，也不能写成 about leaving。
**would** 用作过去将来时，常出现在间接引语和叙述中，表示“那之后将会”：She told me she **would call** back in ten minutes.。当主句是过去时，宾语从句中的 will 必须改为 would，时间副词也要相应调整，例如 tomorrow 变为 the next day。

**was / were to (have) + V3**表示原定的安排，但最后没有实现，或者表示命中注定的事。例如：The concert **was to have started** at eight, but it was postponed.（音乐会原定八点开始。）He **was never to see** his homeland again.（他再也没能回到故乡。）这种结构带有一定的正式或文学色彩。
mistakes: ✗ I was go to the station. → ✓ I was going to go to the station. be going to 中的 going 不能省略，后面接动词原形 go。
✗ I was about leave when she called. → ✓ I was about to leave when she called. be about to 之后要用不定式 to，不能直接接动词原形。
✗ He said he will come the next day. → ✓ He said he would come the next day. 在过去时的间接引语中，will 要改为 would。

examples.text: It was going to rain, so we decided to stay indoors.
examples.translation: 天看起来要下雨，所以我们决定待在室内。

examples.text: I was about to leave the office when the boss asked me to stay.
examples.translation: 我正要下班，老板却让我留下。

examples.text: She told me she would call back in ten minutes.
examples.translation: 她告诉我她十分钟后回电话。

examples.text: The concert was to have started at eight, but it was postponed.
examples.translation: 音乐会原定八点开始，但被推迟了。
examples.note: was to have + V3：原定的安排，未能实现。

examples.text: He was never to see his homeland again.
examples.translation: 他再也没能回到自己的故乡。
examples.note: was to 表示命中注定。

examples.text: They were going to get married in June, but they changed their minds.
examples.translation: 他们原本打算六月结婚，但改变了主意。

examples.text: We were about to order dinner when the electricity went out.
examples.translation: 我们正准备点晚餐，电突然断了。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的过去将来形式。
exercises.sentence: The train ___ leave at six, but it was delayed.
exercises.translation: 火车原定六点开，但晚点了。
exercises.explanation: 叙述的是过去的计划，应用 was going to leave。

exercises.sentence: I ___ the door when the phone rang.
exercises.translation: 我正要关门时，电话响了。
exercises.explanation: 表示“正要做某事”，结构是 was about to + 动词原形。

exercises.sentence: He promised he ___ help us the next day.
exercises.translation: 他答应第二天会帮我们。
exercises.explanation: 主句 promised 是过去时，间接引语中的 will 要改为 would。

exercises.sentence: The meeting ___ held in Paris, but it was moved to London.
exercises.translation: 会议原定在巴黎举行，后来改到了伦敦。
exercises.explanation: was to be held 表示过去的原定安排，其余选项不符合时态或结构。

exercises.source: 我正要睡觉时，朋友打来了电话。
options: I was about sleeping when my friend called.
I about to sleep when my friend called.
I was about sleep when my friend called.
I was about to sleep when my friend called.
exercises.explanation: 表示“正要做某事”用 was about to sleep。

exercises.source: 他说他第二天会给我回电话。
options: He said he will call me back the following week.
He said he would call me back the following week.
He said he would call me back last week.
He says he will call me back next week.
exercises.explanation: 过去时的间接引语中，will 改为 would，the following week 表示“下一周”，与原句含义相符。

options: She was going to visits her aunt.
She was going to visit her aunt.
The train was to have left at six.
exercises.explanation: be going to 之后要接动词原形 visit，不能用 visits。

options: We were about to order dinner when the power failed.
We were about order dinner when the power failed.
The concert was to have started at eight.
exercises.explanation: be about 之后要加不定式 to，应为 We were about to order dinner.。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 我们正要出发，天就开始下雨了。
exercises.explanation: were about to + 动词原形 leave，when 引导的从句表示紧接着发生的事。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 她本打算把消息告诉我，但她忘了。
exercises.explanation: was going to 表示过去的打算，but 之后转折，说明计划未能实现。
